# Ad Skill Jam

> Advertising skills for AI agents and a local, read-only MCP server for campaign inventory.

- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository boundaries, source validation, and approval rules.
- [Platform README routes](AGENTS.md#find-the-right-pack): Direct entry points for all twelve platforms.
- [Platform indexes](ad-skill-jam/README.md): Choose a platform, then read the matching SKILL.md and its linked references.
- [MCP setup](ad-skill-jam/mcp/README.md): Credential-free startup and optional provider reads.
- [Pack validation](ad-skill-jam/_shared/evals/README.md): Format checks and behavior fixtures.
- [Source provenance](ad-skill-jam/_shared/provenance/SOURCES.md): Reference repositories used for each pack.
